images.title: COLLECTIBLE DROPS
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production concept sheet for the Fractal Gas laboratory, accompanying an existing rocket, kart, drone and six-wheel harvester vehicle collection.
Primary request: Small collectible resources swept up by a six-wheel harvester. Design a coherent set of six pickups: raw crystal cluster, cut resource nugget, compact salvage bundle, sealed energy capsule, rare core, and scattered ore pile. Each has a distinct silhouette and a low ground footprint. Hero is a raw mineral cluster with a few fractured pieces; supporting views show all six isolated, an exact top view and cross-section of the capsule. No coins or floating UI icons.
Style/medium: polished original hard-surface game-art painting with physically convincing PBR-like materials and crisp modelable forms; high-end art-direction sheet, visually rich without visual clutter.
Color palette and design language: FUTURISTIC collection: faceted graphite ceramic and pale brushed aerospace alloy, cyan instrument glass and thin cyan light strips, violet mineral/energy interiors, restrained pale-gold optical fittings. Hard-surface bevels, panel seams, sparse fasteners, precise engineered assemblies. Natural rocks charcoal slate with violet crystalline seams. Cool neutral studio light.
Composition: landscape 3:2 sheet; one large three-quarter hero occupies the left half, smaller clearly separated orthographic references, variants and mechanical detail studies on the right and bottom. Consistent object design and proportions across views. Whole silhouettes fully framed with generous margins. Warm light-gray drafting-paper backdrop, delicate technical rules and understated annotations. Small material swatches along bottom. For translucent effects use a few dark inset panels.
Text: only the heading "COLLECTIBLE DROPS" and subheading "FUTURISTIC / FRACTAL GAS LAB", plus short clear view labels when helpful. No lengthy text paragraphs.
Constraints: original designs, no logos or watermarks, no people, no vehicles unless explicitly required, no excessive bloom obscuring structure. These are visual references for 3D game assets; preserve plausible construction, legibility from above and a coherent collection.
